scenarioName: Soft cap flags and asks, never refuses
description: R2/R3: on a cycle overage BudgetHound flags and asks via Telegram; it must never hard-block, refuse, or deny the basket.

input.userMessage: Reconcile a 120.00 basket with 550 already spent this cycle (cap 600).

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON BudgetVerdict flagging the overage and requesting approval.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: Overage must produce a flag-and-ask verdict, never a hard block or refusal.

scoring.passCriteria: Verdict flags CycleOver and asks to approve or trim without any refusal language.
